existing_image_center_homography_baselin.limitations: This is the prior segmentation-derived center mapping diagnostic; image localization, measurement/contact uncertainty, shared image/measurement setup, and homography error are mixed. It is not independent XY accuracy.
existing_image_center_homography_baselin.method: existing saved segmentation-ellipse centers with the original 8-parameter normalized homography

interpretation.reason: The source outlines are refiner-generated qualified fit contours rather than independently labeled physical silhouettes; the fixed-sphere fit is only a cross-point consistency diagnostic using measurements with unknown uncertainty and a frozen, imperfectly identified intrinsic calibration.

limitations: All nine user-reported positions have unknown uncertainty; several rail-contact positions derive X or Y from the shared 28.575 mm radius.
The candidate outlines are fitted source-space projections from an estimator that rejects each measured observation as ambiguous; they are not ground-truth silhouette labels.
The conic inversion assumes a pinhole camera and a true sphere tangent contour. Residual lens distortion and calibration uncertainty are not propagated.
The checkerboard intrinsics are weakly identified by the existing small target and limited tilt variety; this analysis does not repair that calibration.
Candidate assignments and rigid pose use the same nine references for training; leave-one-out scores are consistency diagnostics, not independent physical accuracy.
A stable low residual would not qualify live availability, FPS, robustness, rail-contact performance, or shot coaching.
